projects.name: Barcelona IBX data center (second)
projects.quote: In February, Equinix announcedplans to build its second International Business Exchange™ (IBX ®) data center in Barcelona.

projects.name: Montreal IBX data center
projects.quote: In April, Equinix invested$50 million toward a new state-of-the-art IBX data center expected to open in Montreal in the second half of 2023.

projects.name: Spain renewable Power Purchase Agreements
projects.quote: Year to date, Equinix has significantly increased its commitment to renewable power projects by signing a number of new long-term Power Purchase Agreements (PPAs) in Spain totaling 345 megawatts (MW).
